form:FormGroup.label: Scorer
form:FormGroup.helpText: Compile: the configuration compiles at all. Input coverage: the share of input the parser consumed rather than discarded. Yield: output records per unit of input, against an expected ratio. Schema conformance: the share of records that validate, per record. Extraction quality: typed-element ratio, Unknown rate and required-field coverage. Business rules: XPath assertions over each record. Error load: diagnostics per record. Event classification: records whose type is recognised.

form:FormGroup.label: Weight
form:FormGroup.helpText: How much this score contributes to the weighted total. Zero for a scorer that is a gate only.

form:FormGroup.label: Threshold
form:FormGroup.helpText: The score, from 0 to 1, below which the attempt fails this scorer.

form:FormGroup.label: Gate
form:FormGroup.helpText: A gate must reach its threshold on its own, whatever the weighted total says. Schema conformance is a gate, not something to maximise.

form:FormGroup.label: Expected ratio
form:FormGroup.helpText: Output records expected per unit of input. One per input record for a transformation; an extraction stage sets what its data yields.

form:FormGroup.label: Per
form:FormGroup.helpText: What output records are counted against: input records for a transformation stage, lines or bytes for an extraction stage.

form:FormGroup.label: Schema group
form:FormGroup.helpText: The XML schema group each record is validated against, e.g. EVENTS for event-logging.

form:FormGroup.label: Allow Unknown event detail
form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether records classified as Unknown are tolerated. They never count toward a passing score either way.

form:FormGroup.label: Required fields
form:FormGroup.helpText: XPaths, one per line, that every record must populate, e.g. /Event/EventSource/User/Id.

form:FormGroup.label: Count transform messages
form:FormGroup.helpText: A warning or error the transform raises itself with xsl:message about a record counts as a failed rule for that record.

form:FormGroup.label: Count from
form:FormGroup.helpText: Diagnostics at this severity and above count against a record.

form:FormGroup.label: Recognised types
form:FormGroup.helpText: TypeId values, one per line, that count as classified. Leave empty to count any type other than Unknown.
